title: Would You Rather
description: Impossible choices, two at a time.

questions.question: Would you rather be able to fly, or be invisible?
Would you rather give up music, or movies?
Would you rather always be 10 minutes late, or 20 minutes early?
Would you rather know the future, or change the past?
For a month: give up your phone, or your car?
Would you rather talk to animals, or speak every language?
Would you rather be famous, or rich?
Would you rather fight one horse-sized duck, or 100 duck-sized horses?
Would you rather give up social media, or TV, forever?
Would you rather live in the city, or the country?
Super strength or super speed?
Would you rather lose your sense of taste, or smell?
Would you rather be the funniest person in the room, or the smartest?
Would you rather explore space, or the deep sea?
For a year, would you rather only whisper, or only shout?
Free Wi-Fi everywhere, or free coffee everywhere?
Time machine: visit the past, or the future?
Would you rather have a personal chef, or a personal driver?
Would you rather have a pet dragon, or be a dragon?
Would you rather read minds, or teleport?
Would you rather never be hot again, or never be cold again?
Would you rather win the lottery, or live twice as long?
Would you rather sing everything you say, or dance everywhere you walk?
Would you rather have a rewind button, or a pause button for life?
Would you rather have no internet, or no air conditioning?
Would you rather be a famous actor, or a famous athlete?
Would you rather always have to say what you think, or never speak again?
Would you rather live without pizza, or without burgers?
